title: Canonical scalar universality in the exact-functor unit interface
statement: Let C be an essentially small site category in Type (u+1) with morphisms in Type u, J its Grothendieck topology, R and S commutative rings in Type (u+1), and phi:R→S a ring homomorphism. For module sheaves F over R and G over S and eta:F→Res(phi)(G), the named canonical unbounded scalar universal property scalarUniversal [def-geo-exact-degree-zero-interface] implies DerivedUnit(Res(phi),F,G,eta) [def-sp-exact-functor-derived-unit]. The canonical models and all unbounded test objects are retained; no flatness or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Tag 07A6; canonical exact degree-zero scalar universal property, via scalarUniversal_iff of def-geo-exact-degree-zero-interface

proof.text: Apply scalarUniversal_iff at the general site. Its conclusion is the raw bijection on maps from the degree-zero sheaf G to every unbounded test complex, with the canonical single-functor comparison. This is exactly the defining formula of DerivedUnit. The abstraction at the general site keeps callers from normalizing the concrete localization data.
